pages.title: Pickles and a frisbee · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday noon, and the park in Portland is green and warm. Ana finds a nice spot on the lawn. She spreads a blanket and opens her bag. A child flies a red kite near the trees. A man named Tom walks by with a small dog. He stops and smiles at her.
“Hi! That is a nice spot on the lawn.” says Tom. “Thanks. I have pretzels and a thermos of tea.” says Ana. “Nice. I have sausage and pickles. Do you want some?” says Tom.

pages.title: Pickles and a frisbee · 3/3
paragraphs: “Great. Is the dog friendly?” says Ana. “Very friendly. Come and sit with us!” says Tom. Tom puts his sausage and pickles next to the pretzels. Ana pours hot tea from the thermos into two cups. They eat at the table, far from the ants. After lunch, Tom tosses the frisbee across the lawn. His dog chases it and brings it back. Ana laughs and joins the game.
